Frequently Asked Questions — Nashville

BioLife pays new donors in Nashville approximately $115 per donation and return donors approximately $60 per donation on average in 2026. Actual compensation varies by location, promotions, and donation frequency.

You can donate plasma up to two times per week, with at least 48 hours between donations. Most Nashville donors average 8 donations per month.

Yes, BioLife Nashville frequently offers new donor bonuses and promotions. First-time donors can earn higher rates during their first month, typically around $115 per donation.

Yes, plasma donation compensation is considered taxable income by the IRS. You will receive a Form 1099-NEC if your earnings exceed $600 in a calendar year.
